Question
========
Explain the following concept, spelling out the acronym first if there is one. Give its definition and its usage, and if it has several usages, its most important one.

**Dirty flag in the page table**

Solution
========
A bit set by the MMU when a page has been written to. Its most important use is reclaim: a clean page can simply be dropped, whereas a dirty page must be written back first.
